objective: Generalize the protected GitHub RESULT/1 intake from the inaugural H1 dispatch to any registered OPENMATH dispatch while preserving exact dispatch/operation/issue/bootstrap validation and first-valid-result locking.
invariants: Dispatch must be registered exactly once on protected repository state.
Issue title/body must exactly match the protected dispatch/bootstrap.
assignment_id, agent_ref, concurrency_mode and disposition must match the protected dispatch/operation.
No URLs, Markdown links, HTML links or attachments are accepted in RESULT/1.
First valid result remains the only capturable result for a dispatch.
Existing H1 RESULT/1 remains valid without modification.
claim_boundary: Infrastructure generalization only; no mathematical result or lease is created.
